description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minADE20, comparing the performance of different methods. The x-axis is labeled 'Ratio', has a linear scale, and ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled 'minADE20', also has a linear scale, and ranges from 0.55 to 0.75 with a tick label interval of 0.05. The plot includes five lines representing different methods: TrajICL (blue, solid line with circle markers), Head Tuning (orange, solid line with circle markers), FT (green, solid line with circle markers), LoRA 16 (red, solid line with circle markers), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line with circle markers). TrajICL starts at around 0.61 at a ratio of 0.1 and remains relatively steady, ending at approximately 0.60 at a ratio of 1.0. Head Tuning begins at around 0.79 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to about 0.72 at a ratio of 1.0. FT starts at around 0.68 at a ratio of 0.1, decreases to approximately 0.56 at a ratio of 0.7, and then remains steady until a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 16 starts at around 0.75 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreases to approximately 0.61 at a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 64 begins at around 0.74 at a ratio of 0.1, decreases to about 0.61 at a ratio of 0.7, and then remains relatively steady until a ratio of 1.0.
